verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions folder- or file-level permission roles (viewer/commenter/editor/owner) or how permissions inherit. The only related items cover external sharing, restricting shares to specific email addresses, and revoking permissions. Those are adjacent sharing controls, not the granular role model this story asks for.

support.subject: As an IT admin, permissions are granular — folder- and file-level roles (viewer/commenter/editor/owner) with inheritance behavior documented
